title: Finite supported-image cohomological bound
statement: Let X be a scheme and d≥0. Suppose every affine etale V→X has torsion etale cohomological dimension at most d [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd]. Let tree be a finite qcqs open-closed tree on X, p its path to S [def-sfb-qcqs-open-closed-tree], and v:U→X a pro-affine-etale morphism [sk-def-pe-morphisms]. For any finite discrete commutative ring A [def-pe-finite-discrete-presentation-encoding], internal A_S-modules L,M with finite constant local models [sk-def-sfb-constructible,sk-def-sfb-module-objects], morphism f:L→M and integer q>d, H^q R(condensedModuleSections A U)((v^*p.extension(image f))[0]) is zero [def-sfb-condensed-module-sections,def-sfb-module-upper-star,def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. No prime-power annihilator or Noetherianity is required.

proof.text: Unpack proAffineEtale into a small nonempty cofiltered affine etale presentation U=lim D_i. Each D_i is affine by the definition and every transition between affine schemes is affine. Apply the given hcd to the structure morphisms D_i→X and the affine-limit dimension theorem to conclude cd_tor(U)≤d.

theorem supported_finite_image_cohomology_vanishes
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (d : ℕ)
    (hcd : ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ X) [IsAffine V] [Etale v],
      V.HasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE d)
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (tree : QcqsOpenClosedTree X) (p : tree.Path S)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) (v : U ⟶ X) (hv : proAffineEtale v)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [TopologicalSpace A] [IsTopologicalRing A]
    [DiscreteTopology A] [Finite A]
    (L M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) S)) (f : L ⟶ M)
    (hL : HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) S L)
    (hM : HasFiniteConstantLocalModel (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) S M)
    (q : ℤ) (hq : (d : ℤ) < q) :
    IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Ab.{u + 1} q).obj
      ((condensedModuleSections (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) U).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((CondensedRing.upperStar (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A) v).obj
            ((p.extension (FiniteDiscreteOrdinary.coefficient A)).obj (image f))))))
